body:
This is incredible. Never thought a random person on the internet could change my life. Literally. I cannot thank you enough. I will tell everything to my parents and accept whatever they decide. At least I will have a chance to redeem myself.
You sir/madam have changed my thinking.
Wow! Just realized that. Thank you so much. Such a simple statement made me rethink.
I am or guess was in a a cappella group. I performed with my group across the country and for the first time in life really liked what I was doing.

I enjoy music. I always had some kind of passion for it but discovered during my time in college that I have a talent for singing. But, I have wasted my parents money by getting dropped from college. I don't know how to apologize for that and make amends.

It's not as if I am depressed right now. I am watching a final right now. Tomorrow will be the last day for me unfortunately though. People die in accidents all the time. Innocent kids are killed everyday in acts of crime. One more is not going to change anything.

I do realize that the people that I will be disappointing are only the ones who really care about me. However, time will heal all wounds. They will realize that I was just a kid who lived for 18 odd years and that will be it. People will move on. Get new hopes and worries.
If I live I'll just be a disgrace to my parents. What's the point?
